author: splerg
body:
"The Bomb Squad"

We are some filty scruvy dogs who are looking for a tourney team. schmoopness and Base "anticheat detected" ballshane. A package deal, we can make your team shine. We carried Archon, we carried Girl Gamers (our mini event team), and we will carry your team! Also, we are number 13 in Badlion Iron OCN 2v2s Ladder, jus sayin. So look below for our individual stats and remember, we're a package deal.

Schmoopness

Where do I start, Shane and I go back to both of our first tourney team, Archon, there we met, both scrubs, bad at PvP and lonely. Short after he joined we became m8s, we both improved at the same rate and got better at PvP and less lonely, after Archon we went our separate ways, he went to Syntax and I went to Pekeng. Then, after GoTW we reformed on Casual Girl Gamers, which is where we are now. Unfortunately they're a Mini-event team and this tourney is a full tourney. Skype: nmarx87 Details:• Can pull a bow back and fire it most of the time it hits, but not all of the time.• Can also left click!• Can also play any position well and am really active.• If you ask any of my previous team leaders(Scorched_Arrow, iLoveBokchoy and Axes64) I hold frontlines really well.

Baseballshane

What can I say, schmoop is like a crutch to me and crutches are something that is necessary when you are robbing the hospital while disguised as a patient. My forum ban has prevented me from memeing on the OCN forums and it has left me cold, alone, and broken. HOWEVER! Schmoopness is my bae and he actually gave me the ability to have a dual LFT. So, take us as we are, broken, ugly, and sad. But we broken, ugly, sad things that fit together like the unity of a man and woman in marriage.Skype: lubricatingmc Details:• Can swing a sword and click on people's blocks good• Can fire a bow and sometimes I hit people• Can place a certain block on another certain block• Can break some blocks and make lava go• Can defuse a bomb• Ping's good• Southern

TL;DR:

Shane is CST, Schmoop is PST. Both good at pvping in general, also good at pvping on a team together, can communicate well, sometimes take things as a joke, but can be serious. We both speak english so no non-english speaking teams please. Looking for a tourney team only since we already have a mini event team. We are a package deal.
